definition_canonical.text: Penjaminan Infrastruktur adalah pemberian jaminan atas kewajiban finansial PJPK untuk membayar kompensasi kepada Badan Usaha saat terjadi risiko infrastruktur sesuai dengan alokasi yang disepakati dalam perjanjian KPBU yang menjadi tanggung jawab PJPK.

single_window_and_capacity.text: Penjaminan infrastruktur dilaksanakan oleh PT PII sebagai single window policy. Apabila cakupan kebutuhan penjaminan melewati kapasitas PT PII, dilakukan penjaminan bersama antara Kementerian Keuangan dengan PT PII.

co_guarantee_three_conditions.text: Menteri Keuangan dapat ikut serta dalam penjaminan infrastruktur bila: (1) kekayaan PT PII tidak mencukupi untuk penjaminan sesuai usulan namun penjaminan perlu dilakukan; (2) tidak ada kerja sama PT PII dengan lembaga multilateral/pihak sejenis, atau fasilitas yang ada tidak mencukupi/memadai/sesuai; (3) upaya memenuhi kecukupan kekayaan PT PII belum dapat dilakukan sedangkan pengadaan badan usaha tidak dapat ditunda.
co_guarantee_three_conditions.use_in: brief 01 (capacity/exposure) — this is a fiscal-capacity mechanism, not a claim mechanism

disclosure_location.text: Kewajiban kontinjensi is DISCLOSED in the Catatan atas Laporan Keuangan (CaLK) of the LKPP and reported in the Nota Keuangan fiscal-risk chapter; DJPPR publishes a periodic contingent-liability report carrying outstanding position and guarantee exposure at a stated date. KSAP directs practitioners to SAP for recognition and measurement.
disclosure_location.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH on the mechanism, LOW on any specific number
disclosure_location.researcher_must: Confirm the governing PSAP for contingent liabilities and confirm that a guarantee is disclosed rather than recognised on the neraca until the outflow becomes probable and measurable. This distinction is the article's definition snippet — it must be right.

kpdbu_daerah.text: KPDBU (Kerja Sama Pemerintah Daerah dengan Badan Usaha) is the regional variant term now in active use. PT PII and Bank Jateng signed an MoU alongside an Executive Workshop on KPDBU policy and financing schemes in Semarang, 8 September 2026, covering project assistance, financing-structure work, and identification of potential projects.
kpdbu_daerah.FRAMING WARNING: Several headlines say PT PII 'biayai' / 'membiayai' infrastruktur daerah. That framing is WRONG for us and violates the blacklist. PT PII does not lend or finance. The bank lends; PT PII guarantees and supports preparation. If this MoU is used at all, frame it as pendampingan and penjaminan only, or omit it.
